covered.instructions: Given `test` (one Go test: name, doc comment and first lines) and `siblings` (the other tests of the same package, by name and doc comment), does another sibling check the same user-visible behaviour more completely, so this test adds nothing a user would notice if it were deleted?

criteria.true: A named sibling walks the same behaviour more completely; this one is a detail of it
criteria.false: No sibling covers this behaviour as completely, or this test is the more complete one
